decisions.chosen: Configured environment only, successful non-transient deployment IDs; retain raw capture-day events for staging.
PRs merged into the current default branch with verified merge SHA containment; raw candidate pairs retained.
Count successful production deployment IDs once, including redeployments; exclude capture UTC day.
Assign each merged PR to its earliest observed successful containing deployment; measure merge-to-success hours and exclude capture UTC day.
